crossRefs.note: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

translations.web: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”
translations.bsb: So the king’s attendants answered him, “Haman is there, standing in the court.” “Bring him in,” ordered the king.
translations.kjv: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
translations.asv: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
